scope: Persistent state under /home/tagai/.openclaw/ — mounted into the openclaw container at /home/node/.openclaw/
mount_point_in_container: /home/node/.openclaw/ (all 36 subdirs mount-bound; container is stateless without this volume)

subdirectories.name: .pnpm-store
subdirectories.purpose: pnpm package cache — speeds up plugin/MCP installs in the container
subdirectories.notes: Can be wiped freely; will repopulate on next install. NOT a state dir, despite living in .openclaw/.

subdirectories.name: agents
subdirectories.purpose: Per-agent runtime state — large because each agent has node_modules + code checkouts
subdirectories.notes: Hot data. Loss = re-bootstrapping every agent from scratch.

subdirectories.name: backups
subdirectories.purpose: Intended backup landing zone — currently EMPTY
subdirectories.notes: BUG: this dir exists but nothing writes to it. Either wire a cron or drop the dir.

subdirectories.name: corp
subdirectories.purpose: Corporation/tenant config docs (AI corp blueprint, OKRs)
subdirectories.notes: Critical IP. MUST be backed up.

subdirectories.name: credentials
subdirectories.purpose: Telegram bot pairing + allowlist state (NOT API keys — pairing IDs)
subdirectories.notes: Loss = Telegram bots stop responding until re-paired.

subdirectories.name: cron
subdirectories.purpose: Scheduled task definitions (cron-like) for in-container agents

subdirectories.name: delivery-queue
subdirectories.purpose: Outbound message queue (email/SMS waiting to send)
subdirectories.notes: Loss during downtime = lost outbound messages. Should be on-disk durable (it is).

subdirectories.name: extensions
subdirectories.notes: Effectively empty.

subdirectories.name: flows
subdirectories.notes: High-value IP — these are the actual automations.

subdirectories.name: hindsight
subdirectories.purpose: Long-term agent memory/reflection store (conversation history, learned patterns)
subdirectories.notes: If lost, agents lose all memory of prior runs. PRIORITY backup target.

subdirectories.name: identity
subdirectories.purpose: Agent identity files (names, personas, signing keys)
subdirectories.notes: Loss = agents lose their 'self'. Critical.

subdirectories.name: livekit-agent
subdirectories.notes: 419M is mostly node_modules. Should split: bind-mount node_modules elsewhere, keep recordings in this dir.

subdirectories.name: lobster
subdirectories.purpose: Unknown — name only. Likely a plugin namespace.
subdirectories.notes: TODO: identify purpose. Also see /_tagai/lobster/ in local repo.

subdirectories.name: logs
subdirectories.notes: Should rotate/truncate — not a state dir.

subdirectories.name: mcp-servers
subdirectories.purpose: MCP server installations (microsoft-graph, supabase, tag-ai-functions, etc.)
subdirectories.notes: 244M is mostly node_modules. The .env files inside are the only persist-critical bits.

subdirectories.name: media
subdirectories.notes: Output artifacts. Loss = lost generated content.

subdirectories.name: memory
subdirectories.notes: PRIMARY DATABASE. Daily SQLite backup MANDATORY.

subdirectories.name: plugin-runtime-deps
subdirectories.notes: Can rebuild from package.json. 593M is wasted backup space.

subdirectories.name: plugin-skills
subdirectories.notes: Effectively empty currently.

subdirectories.name: secrets
subdirectories.notes: Should be merged into env files — duplicate secret store.

subdirectories.name: session-delivery-queue
subdirectories.purpose: Per-session outbound queue (vs delivery-queue which is global)

subdirectories.name: skills
subdirectories.notes: Effectively empty currently.

subdirectories.name: tasks
subdirectories.notes: Loss = restart from scratch on any in-flight long-running task.

subdirectories.name: wiki
subdirectories.notes: Core IP — synthesized knowledge from sources. Backup target.

subdirectories.purpose: User workspaces — checked-out projects (SalesEdge, signals-engine, hollywood-studio, hybrid-ai-telemarketing, Michelle-Sanchez-CB-Realty, etc.)
